title: Owner: see a short EVA action light the flow on the iPhone
goal: The owner sees the EVA cage to Misato arrow light for a short action on the installed phone app
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update, ask "remind me to drink water in 2 minutes" from the iPhone app; the flow lights the EVA cage, then the arrow back to Misato, each visibly, before the reply
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.

escalation: The owner decides whether the replay reads clearly; the agent records the result
